title: Generative tools in commercial illustration
text: A survey of 1,200 commercial illustrators found 61% use generative image tools for early concept work, but only 9% deliver AI-generated images as final art. Rates for stock-style illustration fell an average of 18% between 2024 and 2026. Studios report faster client sign-off on concepts.

title: Photography licensing after image generators
text: Stock photo licensing revenue for independent photographers dropped 23% year over year in 2025. Editorial and event photography were largely unaffected. Two major agencies now require disclosure of AI-generated submissions.

title: AI in the recording studio: 2025 musician survey
text: 38% of surveyed working musicians said they used AI tools in production during 2024, mostly for mastering and stem separation. Respondents were union members, mostly full-time professionals (n=2,400).

title: Independent artists and AI: a platform study
text: 22% of independent artists uploading to streaming platforms reported using AI in production in 2025. The sample covers 18,000 hobbyist and part-time uploaders. Royalty pools for ambient and lo-fi genres saw an influx of fully AI-generated tracks.

title: Royalties and synthetic vocals
text: Collecting societies in three countries began separate registration categories for synthetic vocals. Early data shows disputes over voice likeness rose fourfold.

title: Authors, publishers and AI drafting tools
text: Half of surveyed publishers now include AI-use clauses in author contracts. Translation and copywriting saw the largest fee pressure, with median per-word rates down 30%. Literary fiction advances were stable.

title: Screenwriting after the 2023 agreements
text: Writers' guild agreements bar studios from requiring AI use and from treating AI output as source material. Visual effects houses report 20-40% faster previsualisation using generative video, while concept art headcount at large studios fell.

title: Game art pipelines in 2026
text: Most mid-size studios use generative tools for texture variants and placeholder assets. Several high-profile titles faced player backlash over undisclosed AI art.
